text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! Congratulations on the new pothos. 🌿

Since your order was placed after 12 noon on Wednesday, it will ship **next Monday**. Live plants only ship Monday to Wednesday, and your pothos is a live plant. Because your ceramic pot is in the same order, the whole order ships together on that plant shipping day.

Once it ships, here's what to expect:
- **Tracking:** You'll get a tracking email when it ships. It can take up to 24 hours to update.
- **Delivery time:** This depends on your distance from our nearest greenhouse. Standard shipping is 2-3 business days (under 300 miles), 3-5 business days (300-1,000 miles), or 5-8 business days (over 1,000 miles or remote/island addresses). Express is also available in zones 1 and 2.
- **Changes:** Orders can be changed or cancelled free within 2 hours of ordering, so that window has likely passed. Support can try to catch your order before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed.

One more heads-up: if the transit forecast is below 35°F or above 95°F, live plants may be held for up to 7 days, and we'll email you.

If you let me know your order number, I'm happy to help with anything else. Enjoy your new plant, and reach out any time!
